If you notice a squealing or grinding noise when braking, it's often an indicator that brake pads are worn thin. This noise can escalate quickly, leading to more severe damage if not addressed by a professional mechanic in Lilydale.

Another sign is a soft or spongy brake pedal, which may suggest air in the brake lines or a leak in the hydraulic system. In Lilydale's variable weather, especially during wet seasons, compromised brakes can be dangerous. In Lilydale, frequent stop-and-go traffic can accelerate this wear.
